info.name: Narmi Public account balances same-day transfers API
Retrieve fee information for same day transfers

items.docs: Returns the fee structure for same day transfers to calculate the fee for any transfer. All monetary values are represented in minor units, or the smallest unit of the currency with no decimal (e.g., cents). For example, $10.00 is represented as 1000. How can we improve these docs? Share your feedback.
